about_the_game:
All characters in this game are 18 or older.

■Overview■
The year, 202X.
City Kamigui was in danger.
A cursed furnace suddenly appeared out of nowhere in the city,
and heteromorphic monsters called Cursed Demons were spilling out from the furnace.

In order to retrieve peace to the city, Sakura Himemiya transformed herself to
Prisseceal, the Dazzling-and-Flaring Peach Princess, and fought against the demons.

But...

The emerge of the boss of Cursed Demons.
The jockey of a mysterious organization, the Creator Gods.

Will you and Sakura be able to elucidate the intrigues and mysteries of City Kamigui
as you defeat the Cursed Demons and its boss?

Be ready to know the shocking result that awaits you.



■Battle System■
Simple turn-based RPG combat.

■Adventure System■
You'll be able to enjoy adventuring the city since we built the field to be like an open world game.
There's barely any hints like "Go here next." or "Check this out."
You'll have to check and find some kind of hints by yourself.
We added some contents like hidden paths and unsolved mysteries.
These contents are intended to offer you the joy when you find or solve it.
For example, walls that you can clip through, hidden paths, and hidden items are scattered all across the map
so you won't get tired of it. But you can ignore them if you feel it bothersome.
